title: KV cache profile blending and workload-aware validation for INT8/FP8
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Summary: We need a reproducible pipeline for blending INT8 and FP8 KV cache profiles across heterogeneous workloads and a workload-aware validation harness to measure latency/quality trade-offs. The goal is to produce a set of deployable profile blends and an automated acceptance test that prevents regressions during rollout.

Background: Prior KV quantization work (various experiments) shows INT8 and FP8 have complementary failure modes: INT8 tends to be stable on dense autoregressive contexts but can lose tail fidelity on long-context retrieval prompts; FP8 preserves fidelity on some attention heads but increases variance in latency due to kernel selection differences. Current profiles are monolithic and tuned per-model; we need a method to blend profiles dynamically by workload signature to achieve lower p99 latency while bounding quality regression (measured with an evaluation suite).

Hypothesis: A small set of blended profiles (e.g., 70/30 INT8/FP8 on selected layers + head gating rules) chosen by a lightweight workload classifier will meet latency SLOs for interactive workloads while keeping quality regression <= 1.5% on critical evals and no visible user-facing hallucination spikes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define at most 4 blended profiles and a selector that maps workload signatures to profiles.
- Validation harness shows end-to-end latency p50/p95/p99 improvement versus baseline FP16 by >=15%/20%/10% for at least two target workload classes or equal latency with improved cost for at least three classes.
- Quality regression: automated eval suite (LLM-consistency, answer accuracy, reranking NDCG) shows <=1.5% degradation compared to baseline FP16 on critical prompt sets; any profile exceeding 2.5% regression must be flagged and disabled.
- Rollout plan and kill-switch implemented in runtime (config flag + shadow/pipeline validation).

Planned work:
1) Profile design: define per-layer precision masks for INT8/FP8 blending and head-level gating heuristics. Produce a short document with the mapping and rationale.
2) Calibration pipeline: augment existing KV quant calibration job to emit per-workload scale statistics and asymmetric scaling metadata. Add a "blender" stage that produces blended scales and re-quantization parameters.
3) Workload classifier: build lightweight feature extractor (avg sequence len, entropy proxy, token distribution skew, presence of retrieval tokens) and an online classifier that tags incoming traffic into classes. This must be >1000 QPS cheap.
4) Validation harness: expand continuous validation to run mixed-latency microbenchmarks and full model evals under throttling to simulate tail effects. Record generation quality metrics and token-level divergence.
5) Canary & rollout: shadow deploy blended profiles, compare outputs to FP16, and enable automatic rollback on regression thresholds.

Technical plan and metrics:
- Datasets: use internal prompt suites: interactive-chat, retrieval-augmented, long-context-summarization, and batch-embeddings. Include held-out customer-like traces (anonymized).
- Calibration: run per-workload calibration with 20k prefixes each; store histograms for head/layer quant errors.
- Runtime selector: compute signature using rolling window of first 16 tokens plus metadata; selector must add <=0.5ms overhead.
- Benchmarks: measure latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput, and token-cost delta. Quality metrics: token-level perplexity delta, task-specific accuracy (QA F1), and NDCG for reranking.
- Failure budget: any profile that increases p99 latency by >10ms for a key workload is blocked. Any quality drop >2.5% triggers immediate rollback.

Artifacts & links:
- Experimental spec: https://confluence.company/kv-profile-blend-spec (draft)
- Benchmark dashboard (alpha): https://internal-dashboard.company/kv-quant-blend
- Calibration job PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1248

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: workload classifier mislabels traffic causing quality regressions. Mitigation: conservative default to safer FP8-heavy profile with traffic shadowing for 48h before promotion.
- Risk: performance cliffs on rare long-tail sequences. Mitigation: add tail-sampling to calibration and a runtime fallback to FP16 for queries flagged by a tail detector.
- Risk: debug complexity for blended scales. Mitigation: add readable metadata output in traces and extend observability to include per-profile quantization stats.

Deliverables:
- 4 blended profile artifacts + selection mapping (checked into runtime catalog)
- Calibration pipeline extensions and reproducible calibration logs
- Validation harness updates integrated into CI with daily runs and Slack alerts for regressions
- Canary rollout runbook with kill-switch instructions and PR to runtime for rollout automation

Notes for reviewers: Please focus review on the selector heuristics and the calibration sampling plan; head-level gating is where we expect the most sensitivity. If you have recent workload traces that represent customer RAG patterns, add them to the shared S3 bucket used by the calibration job.
comments: 2026-01-15 - Priya Nair: Ticket created with initial spec and acceptance criteria. Assigned to Ethan for implementation. Shared draft on Confluence.

2026-01-18 - Ethan Brooks: Spike complete for selector features; discovered that average token entropy correlates with FP8 regressions. Added entropy proxy to feature set. Spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1248
2026-01-22 - Miguel Torres (review): Recommend increasing calibration prefixes to 20k for long-context prompts; otherwise small sample noise shows false positives. Added to plan.
2026-01-27 - Design review (Ava Chen): UX for observability needs per-profile labeling in Console tracing; filed DES-873 for Console change.

2026-01-30 - Ethan Brooks: First blended profile prototypes (INT8 on layers 0-8, FP8 on higher layers with head gating) run against interactive-chat and retrieval suites. Latency p95 improved by 18% on interactive but QA F1 dropped 0.8% on a retrieval subset. Data uploaded to dashboard.
2026-02-03 - Priya Nair: Added rollout policy and kill-switch notes. Preparing canary for next cycle. Need sign-off from Reliability on p99 budgets before rollout.
